name: Agent knows the Wizard interface
author: wizard
description: Your agent gets a manual of this Wizard's interface (every screen, Settings page and row, and feature switch, on the phone and the computer), generated from the interface code with every update, so it can say exactly where something is without a screenshot. Read by the Agent Service (server/agent-bridge.mjs), which adds the shell's skill to the agent's skills only while this is on. Nothing in the shell changes.
